segments.text: Ok so, this is the headless threads page in the CopilotKit docs, for AG2, and umm, I have implemented this page in my project.

So here, the sidebar lists threads for the agent called my agent.
But the chat has no agent id, so it runs on the default agent.
Basically the two snippets use different agents, so the list never shows the conversation. And ahh, the sidebar never calls on select thread either, so a row couldn't open a thread anyway.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
